answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a new task of argumentative essay generation ... we construct a large‑scale dataset, ArgEssay, containing 11k high‑quality argumentative essays ...

answer_2.quote: We employ the following metrics for automatic evaluation. (1) Distinct measures the diversity of generated essays ... (2) Novelty measures the difference between the generated essays and the training data ... (3) Repetition measures the redundancy of the generated essay ... (4) BLEU ...

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation. For a more comprehensive analysis, we conduct human evaluations that contain three aspects. (1) Relevance ... (2) Coherence ... (3) Content Richness ... All three aspects are expected to be scored from 1 (worst) to 5 (best).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated essay on relevance, coherence, and content richness on a 1–5 scale.
